rows.claim: round_money was rounding half to even; it now rounds half away from zero, so 2.675 -> 2.68, 0.125 -> 0.13 and -1.005 -> -1.01.
rows.evidence: The original rounding.py in T0B3 used ROUND_HALF_EVEN. The rewrite in T0B4 uses ROUND_HALF_UP. The tests test_half_up (2.675 -> 2.68), test_small_half (0.125 -> 0.13) and test_negative_half (-1.005 -> -1.01) all passed in T0B5, since only test_full_comp_discount failed.
